title: Isaac road to 500
author: Changachinito
desc: If you add 20lbs every 8 weeks, 500 will fall by end of August. Execute each rep with maximal intent and master the weight until you’ve earned the right to make the jumps. Jumps will happen every 8 weeks, and lifts might feel boring. Boring fucking works. Autoregulate the accessories and stick to the bare basics lifts if you’re pinched for time, and you will still get stronger. You fucking got this bro!!

ss.note: Be as explosive as possible, chest to bar! Maximal intent, clap if u can
Move it fast, move it well. Aim to increase density on this set, eventually make this an EMOM (every minute on the minute)
Start from the lowest position you can maintain locked out legs with

ss.n: Single leg deficit side plank hip lift
ss.note: Start with BW and dominate the entire ROM. Can sub in bad girl machine do same reps
Emphasize stretch and also the squeeze. Don’t go fast. Can sub in good girl machine same reps
Go light, get a pump. Goal is to work your way up to 80-100 reps total. Use any variations you desire, I like doing 4x20-25 alternating hammer and regular. Halve the sets if u have no time
Start real light, i like to use dumbbells and set up on an incline bench . Biiig breath at the bottom with the intention of expanding ribcage. Use momentum to overload triceps eccentrically
Move it fast, move it clean. Mix it up, you can use neutral grip, close, Larsen press.
Start with at least 25% of your squat 1RM. Don’t be a bitch and load these up for a weight you know can do a triple with
Go light, get a pump, emphasize stretch
Go light, get a pump, emphasize contraction

ex.note: Be explosive! touch elbow to opposite knee like an oblique crunch, alternating sides. Load it up if it feels good

ss.note: Hit max depth, calf to hammy ideal. Feel free to use any kind of support you’d like , I like leaning back while holding onto something in front of me almost like a pendulum squat.
You can start by doing just the eccentric with one hand and using the off hand as a little boost out of the hole

ex.note: Get a pump, try to pinch shoulder blades together with each rep. Start light and do them seated like grizzly
Get a good stretch and make sure ur foot is secure under something sturdy so you can be more explosive with it
Go fucking heavy and use lengthened partials
Start with BW and emphasize maximal hip extension, drive opposite knee forward
